name: godot-kit
description: Godot helpers for Claude Code: checks GDScript with Godot after every .gd edit, shows the result in the status line and feeds errors back to Claude.

godotPath.title: Godot executable
godotPath.description: Full path to the Godot executable (the _console.exe build on Windows). Empty: auto-detect.

projectPath.title: Godot project folder
projectPath.description: Only check scripts inside this project. Empty: any folder that holds project.godot.

checkTimeoutSec.title: Script check timeout (seconds)
checkTimeoutSec.description: How long one Godot check may run before it is abandoned.
